seriesTickers.title: Series tickers
seriesTickers.description: Kalshi weather series to scan, e.g. KXHIGHNY, KXLOWTCHI, KXRAIN. A trailing * selects by prefix (KXHIGH* = every daily-high series). Leave empty for all daily temperature and rain series (about 110).

marketTypes.title: Market types
marketTypes.description: Which daily market kinds to include: high temperature, low temperature, rain (threshold-0 yes/no).

cities.title: Cities or stations
cities.description: Keep only markets whose settlement station matches one of these: a city name (Chicago), an NWS climate code (CLIMDW) or an ICAO code (KMDW). Leave empty for all.

maxDaysAhead.title: Maximum days ahead
maxDaysAhead.description: Markets whose target date is further ahead are listed but not scored (NWS forecasts cover 7 days, Open-Meteo 14).

maxMarkets.title: Maximum markets
maxMarkets.description: Stop after this many markets. Only scored markets are charged.

includeOrderbook.title: Fetch order book
includeOrderbook.description: One extra request per market for best bid/ask with sizes and total depth on each side. The mid price is then taken from the book instead of the market summary.

orderbookDepth.title: Order-book depth
orderbookDepth.description: Price levels per side to request when fetching the order book.

forecastSources.title: Forecast sources
forecastSources.description: The model uses the arithmetic mean of the sources that have a value for the target date. Both raw values are always in the row.

sigmaScale.title: Sigma scale
sigmaScale.description: Multiplier applied to every station's assumed 1-day forecast standard deviation (2.0 to 4.0 F per station, listed in the README). Use it to make the model more or less confident.

leadTimeGrowth.title: Sigma growth per extra lead day
leadTimeGrowth.description: sigma = base x sigmaScale x (1 + growth x (leadDays - 1)) for leadDays >= 1; same-day markets use 0.8 x base.

sigmaOverrides.title: Sigma overrides per station
sigmaOverrides.description: Base sigma in degrees F keyed by station code, e.g. {"CLINYC": 2.5, "CLIDEN": 4.5}. Overrides replace the table value before scaling.

sameDayCutoffHour.title: Same-day cutoff hour (local)
sameDayCutoffHour.description: Markets for the current local day are scored only before this hour at the station; later in the day the outcome is mostly observed and a forecast-based probability would be misleading. 0 never scores same-day markets, 24 always does. Unscored rows still carry the market data and the observed high/low so far.

includeObservations.title: Attach observations so far today
includeObservations.description: For US stations with a same-day market, read the station's NWS observations since local midnight and add the running high, low and precipitation (one request per station).

minVolume.title: Minimum volume
minVolume.description: Skip markets with lifetime volume below this number of contracts.

includeUnscored.title: Include unscored markets
includeUnscored.description: Keep rows for markets that cannot be scored (unknown station, no forecast for the date, rain amount thresholds, target date passed). They carry the market data and a note, and are not charged.
